denial_reason: The records submitted do not document radicular symptoms or a neurological deficit.

docs.author: Dr. Beatriz Campos
sentences: Patient is a 76-year-old man with low back pain for about three months.
Denies bowel or bladder changes, fever, weight loss or any history of cancer.
Sleeps about six hours a night.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
The left Achilles reflex is absent.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
docs.title: Orthopedic clinic visit note

payer_letter: Bluepeak Insurance has reviewed claim A-1053 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of at least six weeks of conservative treatment together with radicular findings or an objective neurological deficit, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document radicular symptoms or a neurological deficit. You may request reconsideration within 90 days of this notice.
